title: Share encryption: hybrid KEM, ciphertexts, decryption, postings and complaints
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/share-encryption-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/share-encryption.md with ML-KEM-768 written from FIPS 203 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 from RFC 8439 in Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or any @noble library; it reuses only group-vectors.py's ristretto255 and RFC 9380 code and ballot-validity-vectors.py's ballot code. Its ML-KEM-768 is checked first against the accumulated FIPS 203 vectors of Go's crypto/mlkem tests and its AEAD against RFC 8439 §2.8.2 and A.5. Every ballot's committed vote passes the validity check, and every decryption, posting and complaint is checked to give the result it lists. The randomness is SHA-512 and SHA-256 of fixed labels: test data only.
